comparison.objective: Insert a circuit board fully into an antistatic bag and place the bag in a crate.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual bag stabilization and broad, thin-part insertion through a compliant-object stand-in.
comparison.success_condition: Board fully enclosed near the bag end; bag placed, released, and stable in the crate without either item falling.
comparison.reason: Although both use bimanual stabilization and insertion, this tests planar packaging rather than coaxial mandrel placement, controlled impact fracture, and fragment recovery.
